rois.note: Inspection sheet check: the embossed RH stamp must be present. IS sheet: Check Mark RH ที่ชิ้นงาน. Needs input_size 1120, not the 672 default: at 672 this box holds only ~16 patches and the verdict rides on the single worst one, which a good part can trip. At 1120 it holds ~27-50 and golden parts sit at 1.49 while a missing/holed mark scores 69-90.
